newsitem.title: USA: Rubin signals he staying on as Treasury chief.
newsitem.headline: Rubin signals he staying on as Treasury chief.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin signalled on Tuesday that he was staying on in the second Clinton administration, though he stopped short of saying so explicitly.
Various press reports have quoted sources close to Rubin as saying he would remain Treasury secretary in Clinton's second term.
"I'm not disagreeing with the press reports," Rubin told reporters at a news conference following a two-day meeting between U.S. and Chinese economic policymakers.
